# Scratch — self-test quiz demo
qa = [
    ("Who created Scratch?", "MIT Media Lab"),
    ("What paradigm is Scratch?", "visual blocks"),
    ("What is creator?", "MIT Media Lab"),
    ("What is first appeared?", "2007"),
    ("What is paradigm?", "visual blocks"),
    ("What is typing?", "dynamic"),
    ("What is file extension?", ".sb3"),
    ("What is hello world?", "(say [Hello, world!] block)"),
]
score = 0
for i, (q, a) in enumerate(qa, 1):
    print(f"Q{i}: {q}")
    ans = input("Your answer: ").strip().lower()
    if ans and ans in a.lower():
        print("Correct.")
        score += 1
    else:
        print(f"Answer: {a}")
print(f"Score: {score}/{len(qa)}")
